records.title: Finch Frontend, Documentation, and Integration Contribution
records.publicText: On the Spring 2026 Finch Robot Web Controller team project, Mark contributed heavily to frontend development. He personally created the Figma mockups, defined the UI layouts and controller-screen direction, contributed to controller screens and frontend interaction flow, and served as documentation manager while contributing to most project documentation. He also created and contributed to GitHub and Finch-installation PowerPoint walkthroughs, taught during walkthroughs, participated in live class demonstrations, helped other students with installation and setup, connected frontend controls to Flask-SocketIO handlers, and contributed to some robot-handler and backend code.
records.shortText: Contributed heavily to Finch frontend development, Figma/UI design, documentation, walkthroughs, demonstrations, student support, and frontend/backend integration.
records.teamContext: Team Software Design and Analysis coursework project. This record covers Mark’s confirmed individual contributions, not sole ownership of Finch.

records.notes: Mark explicitly selected “contributed heavily to frontend development”. Do not replace that phrase with “led frontend development”. Mark personally confirmed the Figma, UI-layout, documentation-manager, walkthrough, demonstration, student-support, Flask-SocketIO integration, and partial robot-handler/backend contributions. Project remained a team effort. Repository fork status should be disclosed when repository ownership is relevant.
